title: Reconstructing the evolution and biogeographic history of tribe Cardueae (Compositae)
markers_or_loci: nuclear ribosomal DNA; chloroplast markers; penalized-likelihood dating; Bayes-DIVA
principal_inference: Produced the principal pre-Hyb-Seq temporal and biogeographic hypothesis for Cardueae and linked diversification to Mediterranean-Anatolian and Himalayan history.
known_limit: few loci relative to current Hyb-Seq and limited within-Cirsium resolution
EAzami_relevance: historical time/biogeographic prior that should be compared with newer nuclear phylogenomics rather than discarded
data_or_access: free American Journal of Botany article

title: Genetic Relationship of Some Cirsium Plants of Korea
sampling: C. japonicum from eight localities plus single accessions of C. chanroenicum C. nipponicum and C. schantarense with GenBank comparisons
principal_inference: Recovered distinct ITS branches for several Korean taxa but placed nodding C. schantarense with upward-flowered C. japonicum despite their orientation difference.
known_limit: linked ribosomal array; sparse one-individual sampling for most taxa; neighbor-joining only
EAzami_relevance: important historical Korean nuclear evidence and direct example that capitulum orientation can differ without strong ITS separation
data_or_access: KCI article; DOI and English abstract verified
